panels.title: Mean mock churn probability (NOT real model validation)

targets.rawSql: SELECT date_trunc('minute', predicted_at) AS "time", AVG(churn_probability) AS "Mock churn risk" FROM churn_predictions WHERE $__timeFilter(predicted_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Maximum discount budget exposure (NOT realized cost)

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", max_exposure_usd::double precision AS "Allocated max exposure ($)", budget_usd::double precision AS "Budget ($)" FROM retention_experiments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT assignment->>'arm' AS "Arm", COUNT(*)::integer AS "Users" FROM retention_experiments e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'assignments') assignment WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Required renewal probability uplift to break even (NOT estimated impact)

targets.rawSql: SELECT assignment->>'arm' AS "Arm", ROUND((100 * AVG((assignment->>'required_absolute_uplift')::numeric)),2)::double precision AS "Required uplift (pp)" FROM retention_experiments e CROSS JOIN LATERAL jsonb_array_elements(e.payload->'assignments') assignment WHERE $__timeFilter(e.created_at) AND assignment->>'required_absolute_uplift' IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Expected renewal revenue at risk (baseline, not saved revenue)

targets.rawSql: SELECT created_at AS "time", (payload->>'expected_baseline_revenue_at_risk_usd')::double precision AS "Expected revenue at risk ($)" FROM retention_experiments WHERE $__timeFilter(created_at) ORDER BY 1
